notes: «ح» splits two branches: the first ends at Ibn Abi Adi, the second at Muhammad; «كلاهما عن شعبة، عن الأعمش» is the shared tail
«- يعني ابن جعفر -» is an editor gloss and is left out, so the second branch's Muhammad is written as the text has him
«واختلفا عن شعبة في تنسيق الأربعة» is a remark about ordering, not a route: left out
